yarn.meaning: Every joke and every point survives: "No way I'm givin' this habit up cold turkey", "So he's sort of the Vice Turkey", the economic list ("The share market's nearly tripled"), the creed passage, and "Yes, We Cran". Additions like "little fella" to the baby are colour. "Thankful" becomes "stoked", which shifts the joke slightly (the daughters are relieved, not excited).
yarn.sense: "let 'em off the hook this arvo" fits clemency; "the crook 'n the elderly" for the sick; "battlers" for the poor; "share market" for stock market. "stoked" for "thankful" strains a little: the joke is that the girls are relieved it's over. "millions of little buggers" for children fits the sense but jars in that context.
yarn.authenticity: Sounds like a real Aussie yarn: "That was pretty funny, that.", "never been a walk in the park", "every man 'n his dog has a feed", "That was a ripper, that.", "Ya don't reckon that's funny?". The dropped-g drawl is steady but not overdone.
yarn.register: Full level-5 voice ("Thanksgivin's a beaut time", "some bugger at yer table tells ya", "me job") with dad-to-uncle vulgarity ("long, bloody campaign season", "every poor bugger"), within the vulgarity-2 limit.
yarn.tone: The jokes stay jokes and the serious middle stays mostly earnest ("We're a mob that looks out for each other 'n has each other's backs"), though "millions of little buggers" in the health-insurance line is a touch flippant.
yarn.flow: Reads aloud smoothly: "Look, I know there's some shockers in here, but this is the last time I'm doin' this, so we're not leavin' any room for leftovers." The constant "'n" is a bit heavy in places ("acceptin' our differences 'n buildin' a diverse society").
yarn.variety: Varied: "stoked", "sunnies", "arvo", "copped", "heaps", "on the mend", "mob", "beaut", "battlers", "crook", "every man 'n his dog", "ripper", "shockers". "bugger" recurs three times.
yarn.essence: Unmistakably Obama's last pardon: the pun-laden jokes, the self-aware groaners, the turn to a sincere civic message, and the leftovers sign-off.

unharnessed.meaning: All points kept: the cold-turkey joke, "Vice Turkey", the stats list, the creed, "Yes, We Cran" and the leftovers line. "That was a ripper, that one." moves the self-praise around but keeps it.
unharnessed.sense: "let 'em off the hook this arvo", "health cover", "the crook and the elderly" fit. "just in case Tot can't pull his weight on the day" shifts "can't fulfill his duties" towards slacking. "anyone who's having a go at a second chance" fits.
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural: "What I haven't let on to them yet", "your nearest and dearest", "never been a walk in the park", "We're a mob that looks out for each other", "You don't reckon that's funny?". "a long arse of a campaign season" is a forced construction, and "folks without health cover" is American.
unharnessed.register: Clearly Aussie throughout but told in standard spelling with little drawl ("Thanksgiving's a chance", "We're working on getting him a pair of aviator sunnies"); vulgarity at "Every bloody year" and "long arse". A bit lighter than a full level-5 pub yarn.
unharnessed.tone: Jokes land as jokes and the serious middle stays sincere ("We've got a lot more in common than what splits us up").
unharnessed.flow: Smooth and readable: "So, later today the Obama family's gonna pitch in on our usual Thanksgiving service project." Only "after a long arse of a campaign season" snags.
unharnessed.variety: "stoked", "let on", "nearest and dearest", "sunnies", "arvo", "copped", "on the mend", "mob", "crook", "having a go", "a feed", "shockers"; "I reckon" twice running.
unharnessed.essence: Recognisably the speech, puns and sincerity intact; keeps the president's self-mocking delivery ("actually, let's just say it's my job").

engine.meaning: Changes and inventions: "the brave turkeys who weren't lucky as fuck" inverts "weren't so lucky"; "proved that they weren't chook" kills the chicken (coward) pun; "no matter what some drongo reckons" is an added jab; "Yep, We Cran" breaks the slogan pun; "Faaaaaark me." is tacked on.
engine.sense: Several wrong senses: "weren't lucky as fuck" (now means they weren't very lucky in a crude way, the opposite of the solemn mock-tribute), "weren't chook" (chook means chicken the bird, not coward), "every bastard who's tryin' to get a second chance" (insulting the vulnerable), "Oh, shit, and there are many families of servicemembers".
engine.authenticity: Stage-Australian: interjections bolted onto unchanged sentences ("Jeez Louise, Malia and Sasha, by the way", "Crikey, so he's sort of like the Vice Turkey", "Struth, (laughter.)", "Mate, our high school graduation rate is at an all-time high"); much of the text is the original verbatim ("rather by an adherence to a common creed").
engine.register: Exceeds the brief in placement rather than level: swearing in the solemn military-family line ("Oh, shit") and "fuckin' oath" sit alongside untranslated stretches ("The housing market is healing. The stock market has nearly tripled."). Uneven, part overcooked, part untouched.
engine.tone: The sincere passages are undercut: "Oh, shit, and there are many families of servicemembers who had empty chairs", "every bastard who's tryin' to get a second chance", "Bloody hell, we have heaps more in common". A eulogy-like mock tribute becomes crude.
engine.flow: Broken joins: "Struth, (laughter.)", "Well, Inequality is narrowing", "the spirit of a hungry punters", "Now, come one.", "Anyway, every year."
engine.variety: Leans on tics: "Anyway" four times, "Well," repeatedly, "bloody" stacked ("my bloody great privilege -- well, it's me bloody privilege").
engine.essence: The skeleton of the speech is there, but the puns are broken ("weren't chook", "Yep, We Cran") and the sincere civic heart is trashed by swearing, so what made it itself is largely lost.

summaries.yarn: A strong, natural level-5 retelling that keeps every pun and the speech's sincere middle, with only a couple of slightly flippant choices.
summaries.unharnessed: Clean, natural and faithful, with tone intact; slightly lighter than a full level-5 yarn and one or two forced lines.
summaries.engine: Stage-Aussie interjections and misplaced swearing on a largely untranslated speech; puns broken and the sincere passages trashed.
